summary: Best week since June. The two things that were on fire last week both came back under control: Lilia lifted her own ban on the chat team talking to frumby on Aug 19 ('And the chatters can talk to Frumby now just make sure they only sell in this folder please') and by Aug 20 reported he is buying again, and the overdue July 15-31 balance was received and rolled into a single consolidated invoice on Aug 15 rather than leaving two invoices open. She paid $500 on Aug 15, Aug 17 and Aug 19 with zero chasing from Stephski and volunteers her own running balance ('1,192 is what I owe! I'm keeping track!'). Content output hit a record: 87 pics + 13 videos on Aug 17 plus a red set on Aug 19, and she built and labelled the high-spender 200+ folder herself because ALTR never did. Two things went backwards. Vivek finally spoke in the chat for the first time since being added on Jul 29 - but she had to ask him three times over two days whether she is shadowbanned on TikTok, Mayson and Mica both had to @ him, and the answer at week's end was 'Not yet busy with instagram unbans'. And Fred's Jul 24 commitment to remove the chatter who keeps reselling owned content is now 28 days old with no chatter ever named and no mechanical guardrail - the only control is still 'informing the team'. Payment is not clean either: ALTR's new Zelle account caps her at $500/day as a new recipient, so $692 was still outstanding on Aug 19 through no fault of hers. That is the second time an ALTR receiving-rail change has forced her into daily installments.
